messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: P1 paging -> Ravenwood (tenant:ravenwood-prod-vpc). High rate of tool-call failures (json parse / extractor errors). Error-rate ~38% over last 5m. Paging eng-sre oncall @maria.g and eng-runtime.

maria.g: I'm on it. Logs show a lot of `failed to extract param: jsonpath '$.user.metadata.id'` and `empty-match` errors from the new jsonpath engine. Affects dedicated pool dedicated-7 (ravenwood-prod).

kevin.l: Can join. This started shortly after last night's runtime roll (v2.14 -> v2.16) at ~03:00 UTC, right?

maria.g: Yep. Errors start ~03:12 UTC in the same timeframe as the roll. Quick grep: many requests that previously returned arrays-of-objects now return empty matches with the stricter semantics in parser v2.

alex: Confirming. The new parser tightened path semantics and changed default array flattening. Ravenwood's toolcall sourcemap relied on the older behavior (implicit flatten). That's why extractions are failing.

tia: Customer impact: Ravenwood's app is getting missing fields and timing out on function calls. They have a dedicated contract; ops and CSM are on standby. We need a short-term mitigation + follow-up plan.

maria.g: Proposed mitigations:
1) Route ravenwood traffic to the compatibility parser (parser_v1) on dedicated-7.
2) Apply an edge extraction shim (fallback to legacy sourcemap) while runtime team prepares a proper fix.
3) Open bridge to Ravenwood support and CSM, inform them we're on it.

kevin.l: I can put the routing override now. Example command (internal console):

```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/routing/override -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"ravenwood","pool":"dedicated-7","parser":"parser_v1","reason":"prod-parser-regression"}'
```

alex: I'll prep a tiny hotpatch for the edge lua filter that tries `jsonpath_v2` then falls back to `jsonpath_v1` when the match is empty. Quick snippet:

```
-- edge filter pseudo
local r = jsonpath_v2(doc, path)
if not r or #r==0 then
  r = jsonpath_v1(doc, path) -- legacy semantics
end
return r
```

maria.g: Oncall handoff note: I'll be primary until kevin confirms the override. After confirmation, I'll watch metrics for 10m then hand to night oncall @tia. Please prepare rollback steps if needed.

tia: Acknowledged. If override doesn't reduce errors, fallback plan: scale dedicated-7 (2x) and route excess to a hosted-compat pool with tenant isolation tags; that'll buy time while runtime teams patch.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: routing override request r-8123 submitted by kevin.l. Approvals: auto. ETA ~45s.

kevin.l: Override applied (r-8123). Routing for tenant ravenwood now targets `parser_v1` on dedicated-7.

maria.g: Monitoring now. Error-rate dropped from 38% -> ~6% in the last 3m. 95th latency also improved. Ravenwood support updated on current mitigation.

maria.g: Handing to @tia for overnight. Context for handoff: regression introduced by parser strictness in v2.16, we've routed to parser_v1. PR with fix/compat shim in review: eng-runtime#4578. If anything spikes, rollback routing with:

```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/routing/override -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"ravenwood","action":"clear","reason":"clear-compat-override"}'
```

tia: Taking it. I'll leave the bridge open and monitor dashboards. Please @me if any regressions reappear. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> customer impact reduced. Next steps: postmortem (eng-runtime + eng-sre), contact CSM and Ravenwood account team, track PR#4578 to completion. Assigned: eng-sre/maria.g, eng-runtime/alex, eng-platform/kevin.l
